assumptions.statement: The overall design boundary is a repository-provided provisional reconstruction, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All area and within-boundary checks are reproducible but must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional; PROV-KEY-003 carries a repository-noted possible location issue.
assumptions.impact: Detailed concepts attach to required district roles rather than claiming parcel-accurate placement.

assumptions.statement: Official control plan, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage and engineering constraints are not supplied.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, road alignment and engineering feasibility remain unknown rather than inferred.

assumptions.statement: Building polygons are program envelopes, not surveyed existing footprints or retain-renovate-demolish decisions.
assumptions.impact: They test spatial capacity and adjacency only; a professional survey must replace them.

assumptions.statement: Twin routes and cross windows express experience networks, not road or rail engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Widths, crossings, accessibility and safety require detailed transport design.

assumptions.statement: Green and public-space polygons are agent-generated design allocations clipped to the provisional boundary.
assumptions.impact: Ratios describe this concept package and are not statutory indicators.

assumptions.statement: Participation volumes, operators and funding are hypotheses, not government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each phase has a public-review gate, an accountable operator gate and a stop/rollback condition.
